body:
**US: Amazon, Monster**
- Amazon fell 94% from Dec 1999 ($106.69) to Sep 2001 ($5.97 pre-split). It did not regain the Dec-1999 closing high until 23 Oct 2009. The Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) fell 63.7% over the same dates — [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2016/06/26/amazon-stocks-history-the-importance-of-patience.aspx); [ChartRow](https://chartrow.com/quote/amzn/drawdown). Whitney Tilson has written up his early Amazon investment lessons — [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/now/whitney-tilson-lessons-investment-amazon-2-decades-ago-131353651.html)
- Monster (Hansen Natural) became a 100-bagger by about 2006 and about a 700-bagger by 2014, per Mayer summaries. Sources disagree on the timing — [Hedge Fund Alpha notes](https://hedgefundalpha.com/strategies/christopher-mayers-notes-100-baggers/); [TIP](https://www.theinvestorspodcast.com/articles/100-bagger-stocks/)
